client_login_disabled.LABEL: Disable direct client logins
client_login_disabled.PLACEHOLDER: When checked, clients cannot sign in to the client panel with their email and password, use the sign-in links in emails, reset their password or use API keys of their own. Clients who are signed in are signed out. Clients can still be signed in by an Integration (e.g. the Manage button and embedded client area of a billing system such as WHMCS) and by administrators using Login as Client. Administrator logins are not affected.

client_login_redirect_url.LABEL: Client login redirect URL
client_login_redirect_url.PLACEHOLDER: Only used while direct client logins are disabled. Clients who open the client panel login page, or a sign-in link from an email, are sent to this address instead, e.g. https://billing.example.com/clientarea.php. Leave empty to show a notice that logins are disabled.

client_default_sso_only.LABEL: New clients: single sign-on only
client_default_sso_only.PLACEHOLDER: When checked, clients created by an administrator or an Integration start with "Single sign-on only" turned on, unless the request says otherwise. It can be changed per client on the client's page. Existing clients, and sub clients created by clients, are not affected.

client_default_sub_clients_disabled.LABEL: New clients: cannot add sub clients
client_default_sub_clients_disabled.PLACEHOLDER: When checked, new clients start with "Cannot add sub clients, super clients or share servers" turned on, unless the request says otherwise. It can be changed per client on the client's page. Existing clients are not affected.

admin_acls.LABEL: Admin IP ACL
admin_acls.PLACEHOLDER: Enter IPs or subnets in CIDR notation (e.g. /29) separated by new lines. As soon as you save, this will take effect, so make sure your IP is included!

integration_acls.LABEL: Integration IP ACL
integration_acls.PLACEHOLDER: Enter IPs or subnets in CIDR notation (e.g. /29) separated by new lines. As soon as you save, this will take effect!

session_duration.LABEL: Session Duration
session_duration.PLACEHOLDER: Default Session Duration, in minutes. Applies to clients and administrators. Sessions auto-renew while active. Set to 0 for no session expiration.

require_admin_2fa.LABEL: Require two factor authentication for administrators
require_admin_2fa.PLACEHOLDER: When checked, every administrator must have two factor authentication turned on and cannot turn it off. Administrators who have not set it up yet can still sign in, but can only reach its setup (Account > Security) until they have. You need two factor authentication on your own account before you can check this. API keys that administrators created for scripts are not affected, and neither are clients.

rate_limit_admin_keys.LABEL: Rate limit admin API keys
rate_limit_admin_keys.PLACEHOLDER: When unchecked, requests authenticated with an Admin-owned API key bypass all rate limiting (login, password reset, 2FA code, SSO).

cors_restrict_origins.LABEL: Limit browser access to the API
cors_restrict_origins.PLACEHOLDER: When checked, only the admin and client panels, the websites listed below and the Allowed Website of each Integration can call the API from a browser. Other websites are refused. If your billing system (e.g. the WHMCS client area) calls the API from its own pages, list its website first. API calls that do not come from a browser are not affected.

cors_allowed_origins.LABEL: Additional websites allowed to call the API
cors_allowed_origins.PLACEHOLDER: Website addresses (e.g. https://billing.example.com) separated by new lines. Only used when browser access to the API is limited.

sso_key_expiration_seconds.LABEL: SSO Link Expiration
sso_key_expiration_seconds.PLACEHOLDER: How long, in seconds, a single sign-on link (welcome, bandwidth, verification and install emails, WHMCS) stays valid before it is used. Minimum 300. Once used, a link stops working 5 minutes later.

reload_on_wipe.LABEL: OS Reload on Wipe
reload_on_wipe.PLACEHOLDER: Enter the OS Profile Billing ID to be loaded on Server wipe, e.g. format-quick to clear disk partition tables or format-slow to fully zero all disks.

catalog_auto_sync.LABEL: Templates Catalog Sync
catalog_auto_sync.PLACEHOLDER: When enabled, automatically syncs OS templates from the catalog server.

set_disk_boot_on_install.LABEL: Switch boot device to disk after OS install
set_disk_boot_on_install.PLACEHOLDER: When enabled, the server's IPMI permanent boot device and one-time boot flag are set to disk when the OS installer reaches the packages step, and again when the last install for the server is deleted. Disable this if you manage boot order outside of SynergyCP (e.g. servers left on network-first boot order, or a DHCP/iPXE setup that hands off to the local disk).

poll_granularity.LABEL: Bandwidth Poll Granularity
poll_granularity.PLACEHOLDER: Number of minutes between bandwidth polls. Smaller granularity (e.g. 1 minute) means more accuracy, but requires more storage space and slows down bandwidth graphs
